topics.name: Data Minimization Profile
topics.purpose: Define exact minimum data fields/scopes required for a declared purpose or operation, with excess data excluded by default.

semantics.identity_rule: Each reusable minimization profile has explicit identity.
semantics.derivation_rule: Derived data remains subject to minimization.
semantics.collection_rule: Input collection should reject/omit unnecessary fields according to profile.
semantics.projection_rule: Outputs expose only required permitted fields.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: collect all then decide later by default
